args:
gcloud builds describe \
  544a65df-2a37-4fb8-b207-870dabee263c \
  --project=nfl-predictions-503414 \
  --format=json > /workspace/predecessor-build.json
gcloud builds log \
  544a65df-2a37-4fb8-b207-870dabee263c \
  --project=nfl-predictions-503414 \
  > /workspace/predecessor-build.log 2>&1
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path

build = json.loads(Path("/workspace/predecessor-build.json").read_text())
assert build["id"] == "544a65df-2a37-4fb8-b207-870dabee263c"
assert build["status"] == "FAILURE"
expected_source = {
    "revision": "f81d02fd143f3cb5318eee1d795099fe2b167c39",
    "url": "https://github.com/espechtsoftware/nfl-predictions.git",
}
assert build["source"]["gitSource"] == expected_source
assert build["sourceProvenance"]["resolvedGitSource"] == expected_source
steps = build["steps"]
assert [row["id"] for row in steps] == [
    "full-test-suite", "build-image", "smoke-atlas-mvp-runner",
]
assert steps[0]["status"] == "FAILURE"
assert steps[0]["exitCode"] == 1
assert "PYTHONPATH=src pytest" in "\n".join(steps[0]["args"])
assert steps[1]["status"] == "QUEUED"
assert steps[2]["status"] == "QUEUED"
assert not build.get("results", {}).get("images")

log = Path("/workspace/predecessor-build.log").read_text()
summary = "8 failed, 3328 passed, 4 skipped, 1569 warnings in 5570.61s"
assert summary in log
failures = {
    line.split("FAILED ", 1)[1].strip()
    for line in log.splitlines()
    if "FAILED tests/" in line
}
assert len(failures) == 8
assert all(
    row.startswith("tests/test_validate_a7_v2_source_lineage_extension.py::")
    for row in failures
)
PY
steps.name: gcr.io/google.com/cloudsdktool/cloud-sdk:slim

args:
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git libgomp1
pip install --no-cache-dir '.[gcp,app,dev]'
PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q \
  tests/test_validate_a7_v2_source_lineage_extension.py \
  tests/test_corpus_retrieval_transport.py
steps.name: python:3.11-slim

args:

docker run --rm 'us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/nfl-predictions-503414/nfl-dfs/nfl-dfs:corpus-retrieval-cont-bfe2e48' \
  python scripts/run_corpus_retrieval_transport.py parked | \
